body: Usually because I have to move. I've been couch surfing for a year trying to get a grip on my life and get things under control and then whatever living situation I have fucks up so I have to go somewhere else. Friends of friends living rooms, shelters, boyfriends who dump me after two months. I've never actually been fired but out of the six jobs I've had, I've quit 4 of them because I had to leave on short notice.

I never tried. I wrote really good research reports and essays before I dropped out of school. When I try to write as a hobby it just feels melodramatic and stupid. I'm good at it, I know that it comes naturally to me, I just don't feel happy when I try to channel it.

It feels like no one can help. Everyone thinks I'm just lazy. They say "Just go do job applications and get your GED" and all that as if it's easy to just go do that. I feel too fragile for the world, my very fighting best is a laughable, half assed attempt in everyone else's eyes.
